Welcome to 2 Blessed 2 be Stressed!



2 Blessed 2 be Stressed is the perfect beach home for the family ~ it is a beautiful, two-story, custom-designed home, located in the popular community of Summers Edge. With a short 2-minute walk to the beach, and access to two community pools, one of which is seasonally heated, 2 Blessed 2 be Stressed is destined to become your family's favorite spot year after year!



Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, and tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family! As if this weren't enough this home now comes with a *FREE 6 seater golf cart and 4 adult bikes available for use during your stay!!!



As soon as you enter 2 Blessed 2 be Stressed, you will be greeted by the open-concept main living area that brings together the newly renovated kitchen, the dining room, and living room. Full of coastal charm and décor, you are going to feel right at home in this charming beach house! With plenty of seating and a flat-screen T.V., the living room is the perfect place to unwind after a day full of fun. The large dining room table is perfect for families, with seating for 10, plus 4 more at the brand new breakfast bar! The kitchen is spacious and fully stocked to cook delicious meals on those nights you want to stay in! Also, on the first level is a bunk room, perfect for the kids with two twin-sized bunk beds.



Off the back of the home, is a patio with a gas grill and dining set, the perfect spot to grill delicious meals and have a nice dinner outdoors!



As you make your way up to the second floor you will find three bedrooms. The first is the master suite with king sized bed and private bathroom. This bedroom also has access to a private balcony! There are two guest bedrooms, one of which with a king bed, and the other with two sets of twin-sized bunks!



Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps (12)

1st Floor:

- Bunk Room with Twin Sized Bunks

- Walk-in shower

- Washer & Dryer

- 1/2 Bathroom

- Sleeper Sofa



2nd Floor:

- Primary Suite-King Sized bed with Private En Suite, newly renovated with a soaking tub and walk-in shower - Private Balcony

- Guest Bedroom-King Sized Bed-Balcony

- Bunk Room- 2x Sets of Twin Sized Bunks

- Shared Bathroom with walk-in shower



Amenities:

- FREE *Golf Cart (Requires signed waiver and proof of valid drivers license and insurance prior to use.)

- Walk to the Beach

- Parking for 2 Cars

- Multiple Large Balconies

- 2x Community Pools / 1x Heated

- BBQ Grill on Back Patio

- Washer and Dryer

- 1.8 Miles to Seaside

- Free WI-FI



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Starter Amenity Package:

All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



FAQ:

Type of coffee pot: K cup or standard coffee pot

Parking for 2 vehicles +LSV MAX, additional street parking, 1st come, 1st serve.

Distance to beach: short 2-minute walk through Summer's Edge neighborhood to the private beach

Bikes included: Yes (A waiver does need to be signed)

Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: No

Community Pool heated: Yes (Heated seasonally per the HOA's discretion.)



Summers Edge is just 1.8 miles from the town of Seaside. The community is just minutes away from shopping, restaurants, and many other activities in Seaside, Watercolor, Rosemary Beach, Destin, and Panama City. There are great bike paths, lakes, the beach, and state parks nearby to provide plenty of outdoor activities.



*Golf Carts are not allowed to be rented in this community. Guests may use a golf cart if the owner of the home owns one and allows their guests to use it.



**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**



Guests are responsible for any damage to or towing of golf carts during their stay. Misuse or negligence resulting in repair or replacement costs will be charged to the guest. Please operate carts safely and follow all guidelines. Use implies acceptance of these terms.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
